answer: Reputation decays with an exponential half-life, so a node must provide sustained, honest service to retain influence; brief activity cannot bank trust indefinitely. In the EigenTrust matrix, a freshly spawned sybil has near-zero eigenvector centrality because it lacks trusted paths and reciprocal endorsements, and therefore cannot pass consensus. An opal-bright claim, kernel-level identity trick, or plume of coordinated accounts cannot substitute for durable, independently earned trust.
